comments.overrides: exceljs, googleapis and node-cron pull in uuid v8/v9, which carry a bounds-check advisory in the v3/v5/v6 code paths. All three only ever call uuid.v4(), so they aren't exposed, but pinning the patched line clears the audit without a major bump of the packages themselves. Verified against the parser and scheduler smoke tests.
